clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Names 19 New National Heroes Of Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially awarded the title of National Hero to 19 selected figures.
The list of recipients includes RM Margono Djojohadikusumo, Hoegeng Imam Santoso, Maraden Panggabean, and KH Wasyid.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Vice President Gibran Remains in Office Amid Resignation Talk
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka stated he intends to remain in office and pursue legal action regarding a diploma dispute.
President Prabowo Subianto reportedly advised the Vice President to continue the legal challenge rather than resign from his position.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Dismiss Senior Officer Over Presidential Wiretap
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police dismissed Inspector General Ahrie Sonta following an internal ethics hearing.
The disciplinary action is linked to an investigation regarding the illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka Addresses Educational Diploma
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka has requested an opportunity to prove the authenticity of his education documents in court.
Legal experts, including Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra, suggest that such legal efforts are redundant following final Supreme Court rulings.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Lawmakers Advance Opinion Rights Regarding Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Fifty members of the Indonesian House of Representatives have formally signed a proposal to initiate an opinion rights procedure concerning the Vice President.
Parliamentary leadership has acknowledged the petition while confirming they respect parallel legal proceedings currently underway at the Administrative Court.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Announces Winners Of The Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The Jakarta provincial government recognized local environmental contributors through the Pilah Olah Sampah Heroes 2026 program.
Winners of the initiative will serve as ambassadors for the provincial government to promote waste management practices.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Ruling On Vice President Gibran Diploma Finalized
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court ruled that there is no evidence verifying Gibran Rakabuming Raka possesses a high school-equivalent diploma from abroad.
The court ordered the Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education to revoke the certificate of equivalency previously issued to the Vice President.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Parliamentary Session Sees Calls For Gibran To Resign
aiSummaryBullets: Legislators and protesters have publicly demanded the resignation of Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka during and after a plenary session.
The Prosperous Justice Party suggested that a voluntary resignation would be preferable to a formal impeachment process in the legislature.

clusters.headline: Three Prominent PSI Leaders Resign To Focus On Government Roles
aiSummaryBullets: High-ranking members Giring Ganesha, Raja Juli Antoni, and Isyana Bagoes Oka have formally stepped down from the Indonesian Solidarity Party.
The officials cited the need to dedicate their full attention to their respective responsibilities within the government.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Advocates For Global Climate Solutions At The COP31 Summit
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia is presenting its national energy transition efforts as a scalable climate solution at the COP31 conference.
Government representatives have called for global cooperation between investors, scientists, and business leaders.
